questions.question: OP-01 review 9 left O119 and O120 (reopens) and O121 to O124 (notes) open, so the record can't be frozen. What next?

options.label: Close-out now (Recommended)
options.description: Run /observe-review OP-01 close-out in a fresh session: one dialog proposes an answer for O119 and O120 and routes O121 to O124 to the spec flow, then the C3 check runs. This is how O111 to O117 were closed after review 8.

options.label: Reopen session
options.description: Walk O119 and O120 in a full /observe OP-01 session, then run another full /observe-review. Slower, but each reopen gets its own dialog and a fresh review.

options.label: Stop here
options.description: Leave the items open on the branch. Freeze-2 (BK-506) stays blocked.
